protocol.role: development mechanism diagnosis; no independent arrival seeds
protocol.source_policy: frozen always-lookahead with weight 1 and 1% support cap
protocol.state_roster: every source frame where v4 and lookahead differ in departures, duration or sorted class completion offsets, including drain
protocol.intervention: same source prefix; force v4 versus lookahead once; both continue with v4 K26 to drain the identical original population
protocol.prediction: frozen J=A+EV; all delta signs lookahead-first minus v4-first, units job-seconds
protocol.realized_target: N times paired mean-flow difference; identical prefix contributions cancel
protocol.area_partition: current/future use each branch's own first-frame boundary, which may differ in absolute time
protocol.cutoff: h=min(tau,max(H-start,0)); truncated current arrival area Lambda*(tau*h-h*h/2); terminal Poisson mean lambda*h
protocol.residual_identity: delta F-delta J = cutoff correction + realized current arrival residual + realized next-queue residual + future area minus realized terminal value
protocol.diagnostic_work: offline queue memoization: search and prediction counters cover selector cache misses; additional action audits and replay frames counted separately; forced replays are not new budgeted schedulers
protocol.stopping_rule: all substitutions on all nine source trajectories, once; no state filtering based on outcomes or policy tuning

limitations: Interventions share development tapes and overlapping futures; cases are not independent replicates and their effects cannot be summed to infer whole-policy improvement.
The continuation target includes subsequent arrivals and v4 decisions; its residual against V is not a pure terminal-function bias estimate.
Only states visited by the frozen lookahead policy are studied; results need not apply to v4-only states or other continuation policies.
